PDF Vectorisation Pipeline 
Assessment - LangChain / LangGraph Implementation 
Language Python (required) 
Framework LangChain / LangGraph 
 
OVERVIEW 
Build a pipeline with two components using LangChain: (1) an ingestion script that loads a PDF using a LangChain 
document loader, splits it with a LangChain text splitter, generates embeddings via a LangChain embedding 
integration, and persists them to a LangChain-compatible vector store; and (2) a retrieval endpoint that queries the 
vector store directly using similarity search. There is no LLM call on the retrieval side and no QA or conversational 
chain. Return raw chunk results only. 
PART 1 - INGESTION 
Write a script using LangChain primitives that performs the following steps in order: 
1. Load the PDF using a LangChain document loader (e.g. PyPDFLoader, PDFMinerLoader, UnstructuredPDFLoader).

example: load → split → embed → store. Include a printed node list or a diagram in your README. 
PART 2 - RETRIEVAL ENDPOINT 
Expose a single HTTP endpoint. Embed the incoming query using the same model from ingestion and call 
similarity_search_with_score() (or the equivalent method) on the vector store. Return the top-k results directly. 
Method Endpoint Description 
POST /query Request body: { "query": string, "top_k": int }. Response: array of { chunk_text, 
page_number, score }. 
 
Do not wrap retrieval in a RetrievalQA chain, ConversationalRetrievalChain, or any LLM chain. The endpoint must 
call the vector store’s similarity search method directly and return raw results. 
 
CONSTRAINTS 
• Python is required. LangChain core must be used for loading, splitting, embedding, and vector store operations. 
• LangGraph is optional but will be evaluated positively if the graph is well-structured and documented.
